chunks: And in the narration of ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, he said:
"If you enter ihram while there remains for you from Rajab a day and a night, then your ʿUmrah is Rajabiyyah."

key_terms.أَحْرَمْتَ: you entered into ihram for the ritual state of pilgrimage or ʿUmrah
key_terms.لَيْلَةٌ: a night remaining from the month
key_terms.يَوْمٌ: a day remaining from the month

ai.seo_question: When is an ʿUmrah considered a Rajabi ʿUmrah?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the timing of ʿUmrah in the month of Rajab. It states that if a person enters ihram while one day and one night of Rajab still remain, the ʿUmrah is counted as a Rajabi ʿUmrah.
